name: com_explorer
description: Direct Windows Shell.Application COM connector for File Explorer. Allows zero-token instantaneous folder opening, path navigation, window enumeration, and selected item retrieval.

action.description: Action: 'list' open Explorer windows and paths, 'open' navigates/opens a folder path, 'get_selected' gets selected files.

path.description: Filesystem path to open (required for action='open').
